snippet.title: Ascension: The Immortal Alchemist -  Gameplay Teaser HD
snippet.description:
Kybalion must confront a Labyrinthine Nightmare, where he is trialed by cosmic forces to secure the ascension of his soul.

A Mesocore (rage game) Precision Platformer, Escape Room and Speed Runner set beneath the sands of Giza in the perilous Lost Labyrinth of Egypt.
